description: This file defines the Dispatcher interface within the FastRoute namespace, specifying constants for dispatch status, and a method signature for dispatching HTTP requests based on method and URI.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for dispatching HTTP methods and URIs, including constants indicating dispatch results.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Method to dispatch an HTTP request based on method and URI, returning an array that indicates whether the route was found, method not allowed, or not found, possibly including the handler and variables.
